summary: Unlock the potential of AI in your business with our expert-led training. Gain insights and skills to drive transformation and stay ahead of the competition.
lede: AI business transformation training helps business, digital strategy, operations, and change professionals assess AI opportunities and plan controlled adoption. It covers readiness and data-quality assessment, use-case design and prioritization, governance and operating-model planning, and transformation roadmaps with stage gates and executive reporting. Learners also work with responsible AI principles, risk checkpoints, stakeholder roles, and measures for value, adoption, and cycle time.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn AI ambition into practical business change across operations, customer journeys, and support functions.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a willingness to work with planning templates, and access to a sample process or transformation challenge from your own organization if available. Familiarity with business cases, process maps, or transformation roadmaps will help you move faster, but no programming or technical model training is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
